contour.assessment: Seven scalar levels and their grid-edge crossings agree. Moxi fixed-diagonal marching triangles and upstream marching squares connect crossings differently inside cells. Full isoline geometry parity remains open; padding, palette, grid and labels also differ.

contourf.assessment: The same seven thresholds produce eight bands and Moxi covers the complete source grid. Moxi clips fixed-diagonal triangles; upstream fills marching-squares above-level regions. Band topology/area equality against upstream is unverified; native seams, palette, padding and labels differ.

tricontour.assessment: Fixture mesh and all three isoline levels agree. Moxi accepts supplied meshes; upstream computes Delaunay connectivity. Arbitrary mesh parity is unverified. Axis padding, palette, grid and missing Moxi labels differ.
